hints.text: Click to select, or click in empty space and drag to marquee select. Use Shift, Opt, and Cmd for other options.
Click to select all clips to the right in all tracks. Shift-click for a single track.
Click to select all clips to the left in all tracks. Shift-click for a single track.
Drag an edit point to ripple trim; later clips move to keep the gap closed.
Drag an edit point to roll it: the out of one clip and the in of the next move together.
Drag an edge to change the clip's speed so it fills the new duration.
Drag the edge of a music clip to remix it to the new duration at musically matching beats.
Click to split a clip. Shift-click to split all tracks.
Drag a clip to slip its source in/out without moving it.
Drag a clip to slide it between its neighbours.
Click to zoom in; Opt-click to zoom out.
